Specification: This module provides alternative definitions of standard TLC operators for Apalache compatibility rather than modeling a distributed algorithm or protocol. It defines stubs and typed versions of operators such as function construction, composition, printing, assertions, time access, TLC state accessors, permutations, sorting, random element selection, string conversion, and evaluation. The design intentionally avoids imperative or runtime-specific TLC behavior by replacing it with symbolic-execution-friendly definitions, often using CHOOSE, LET, function constructors, and simple placeholder values; the file contains no temporal system specification, no state variables, no fairness assumptions, and no verified safety or liveness properties.
